entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: Temporary user identity for 5GS-based services used for identification within signalling procedures. Globally unique in PLMN and unique within SNPN. Consists of GUAMI and 5G-TMSI components.

entities.name: 5G-S-TMSI
entities.description: Shortened form of 5G-GUTI used in paging and service request procedures for more efficient radio signalling. Provides identity confidentiality.

entities.name: GUAMI
entities.description: Main component of 5G-GUTI that identifies the AMF(s).

entities.name: 5G-TMSI
entities.description: Main component of 5G-GUTI that provides unambiguous identity of the UE within the AMF(s) identified by GUAMI.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message where UE includes valid 5G-GUTI if available.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message where UE includes valid 5G-GUTI if available.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message where UE includes valid 5G-S-TMSI as user identity.

entities.name: Initial registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which AMF assigns new 5G-GUTI upon successful completion.

entities.name: Mobility registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which AMF assigns new 5G-GUTI upon successful completion.

entities.name: Periodic registration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which AMF should assign new 5G-GUTI upon successful completion.

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure that AMF may use to assign new 5G-GUTI at any time.

entities.name: Timer T3519
entities.description: Timer that UE stops when receiving new 5G-GUTI.

entities.name: Delete stored SUCI
entities.description: UE action to delete any stored SUCI when receiving new 5G-GUTI.

entities.name: 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication
entities.description: State entered when N1 NAS signalling connection is suspended due to user plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

relations.description: 5G-GUTI contains GUAMI as one of its main components.
5G-GUTI contains 5G-TMSI as one of its main components.
5G-S-TMSI is a shortened form derived from 5G-GUTI.
SERVICE REQUEST message contains 5G-S-TMSI as user identity.
Successful initial registration procedure establishes new 5G-GUTI assignment.
Successful mobility registration update procedure establishes new 5G-GUTI assignment.
Successful periodic registration update procedure should establish new 5G-GUTI assignment.
Generic UE configuration update procedure may establish new 5G-GUTI assignment.
Receipt of new 5G-GUTI stops timer T3519 if running.
Receipt of new 5G-GUTI establishes deletion of any stored SUCI.
5G-GUTI assignment timing is constrained by 5GMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication state.
